gloss: to hesitate; to be reluctant; to refrain from

definitions.gloss: to hesitate; to be reluctant; to refrain from
definitions.explanation: to hold back from doing something out of consideration, propriety, or fear of consequences
to exercise power or influence without restraint (often in the set phrase {憚|はばか}ることなく)

examples.english: To be mindful of others' eyes (to act discretely).

examples.japanese: {憚|はばか}りながら{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: I humbly venture to say (with all due respect)...

examples.japanese: {憚|はばか}ることなく{意見|いけん}を{述|の}べた。
examples.english: He stated his opinion without hesitation.

examples.japanese: {批判|ひはん}を{憚|はばか}らない{態度|たいど}だった。
examples.english: It was an attitude that didn't shy away from criticism.

notes:
{憚|はばか}る has nuances of hesitation out of respect or propriety.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {人目|ひとめ}を{憚|はばか}る (to be conscious of others watching)
- {憚|はばか}りながら (with all due respect; humbly)
- {憚|はばか}ることなく (without hesitation)
- {世間|せけん}を{憚|はばか}る (to be mindful of public opinion)

NEGATIVE FORM MEANING:
{憚|はばか}らない or {憚|はばか}ることなく often means "without restraint" or "boldly."

FORMAL EXPRESSION:
{憚|はばか}りながら is a humble expression used before stating something that might be presumptuous.

EUPHEMISTIC NOUN:
お{憚|はばか}り is a euphemism for "toilet" (polite/dated).

SET PHRASE:
{憚|はばか}りさまでした (old polite expression after someone has done work)

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive/transitive (takes を in some uses).

RELATED TERMS:
- ためらう (to hesitate - general)
- {遠慮|えんりょ}する (to refrain, hold back)
- {躊躇|ちゅうちょ}する (to hesitate)

REGISTER: Formal/literary. Common in formal speech and writing.
